source: ECB reference exchange rates, U.S. Treasury, ECB, Bank of England, Bank of Japan and BIS policy rates
methodology: Covered-interest-parity forward uses quote-currency benchmark rate minus base-currency benchmark rate. Benchmarks mix short market rates and policy rates, so tenor and cross-currency basis differences remain. The indicative distribution blends trailing 12M momentum (50%), annualized 3M momentum capped at ±50% (30%), and the annual rate differential (20%). INR is shown as an institutional forward/NDF research case rather than being proxied with an India equity ETF. It is a research prior, not a guaranteed forecast.
